WHAT: Claude Code HTTP hook scripts receive input via stdin as JSON, not env vars. CLAUDE_SESSION_ID, CLAUDE_TOOL_NAME etc. do not exist as environment variables.

HOW: Hook script pattern:
```bash
#!/bin/bash
HOOK_INPUT=$(cat)  # MUST read stdin first
SESSION_ID=$(echo "$HOOK_INPUT" | jq -r '.session_id // empty')
TOOL_NAME=$(echo "$HOOK_INPUT" | jq -r '.tool_name // empty')
TOOL_INPUT=$(echo "$HOOK_INPUT" | jq -c '.tool_input // {}')
CWD=$(echo "$HOOK_INPUT" | jq -r '.cwd // empty')

# Then POST to server:
curl -s -X POST http://localhost:3000/api/hooks/pre-tool-use \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  --max-time 29 \
  -d "$HOOK_INPUT" || true
```

Also inject tty for terminal focus:
```bash
TTY=$(tty 2>/dev/null || echo '')
HOOK_WITH_TTY=$(echo "$HOOK_INPUT" | jq --arg tty "$TTY" '. + {tty: $tty}')
```

WHERE: ~/.claude/hooks/pixel-office-*.sh

GOTCHA: If you read stdin into a variable, subprocesses can't read it again. Capture once at the top.
